method.analysisArray: 160x90 BOX RGB; Rec.709 luma from encoded sRGB values (display luminance proxy, not radiometric)
method.motionNormalization: 15 local 22x22 patches, +/-8-pixel normalized correlation search and subpixel quadratic peak; bilinear translated residual
method.limits: Patch translation does not fully compensate perspective, rotation, parallax, water/cloud motion or occlusions. Statistics flag candidates, not confirmed artifacts. No GPU, browser or active-capture modification.
